verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage Mesh documents a public REST API. It covers token-based authentication with configurable API credentials, customer creation and sync/async/batch screening, and case/alert remediation via the API. It also offers registrable webhooks, rate-limit headers, a Postman collection, a downloadable OpenAPI schema, and an llms.txt index. The probe's 404s on guessed OpenAPI paths do not contradict the documented schema download. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the API in use, and a machine-discoverable OpenAPI spec at a standard path.
